title: 18447 - 18447/P2015/008213
commonCauses: Engine Kontrol Modülü Software/Firmware Version faulty
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Emme Manifoldu Flap Motor (V157) faulty
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Emme Manifoldu Flap Motor (V157)
Gerçekleştirin: Output Tests/Basic Setting
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Emme Manifoldu Flap Motor (V157)
technicalNotes:
Kontrol edin:  TSB 24-17-04 or 2045138 NAR) North American Region vehicles only.
2006 - 2008 BPY and 2008 - 2016 CCTA and CBFA engines.
Improved Emme Manifoldu design.
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2017/MC-10158548-9999.pdf   NHTSA
In some Cases the Issue can only be resolved by Replacing the whole Emme Manifoldu.
The Emme Manifoldu Flap Motor (V157) and Manifold Runner Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G336) may be Part of the same Unit.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: a VW Golf/Jetta (1K): 1.9l PD-TDI (BRM), Kontrol edin: Engine Kontrol Modülü (ECM) Software Version:
03G-906-016-AB @ 7328 or 7550 as well as 03G-906-016-AC @ 7280 or 7551 do have a Software Error which requires a special Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon:  for the Emme Manifoldu Flap Motor (V157) which at this Point can only be performed with the Factory Tool.
This page describes a Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  for some 2.0T gasoline engines: 2.0l_TFSI_(AXX/BGB/BPJ/BPY/BWA)#Emme_Manifold_Runner
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: North America Audi vehicles Kontrol edin: Technical Service Bulletin number: 2044003
This TSB addresses possible issues with the N316 - Emme Manifoldu Flap Valve
